# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v2 c27 P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Second-primer schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v3 c1 P34](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0034), [v3 c28 P2](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0002)</sub>; Robin  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is an attractive young boy with a round skull covered in tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets. His face features dancing, elfish hazel eyes, a snub nose, a perpetually smiling mouth, and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a sweet, amusing appearance when he chuckles. As he gets older, he grows visibly taller and broader.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 c25 P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071), [v3 c40 P5](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0005)_

## Personality

Robin is an enthusiastic, cheerful, and good-humoured boy who naturally captures affection. Highly curious and inquisitive, he constantly asks imaginative questions and tests ideas himself. Though naturally mischievous, careless, and prone to forgetting his chores, he is easily comforted and possesses an affectionate, emotional nature. He enjoys playing games with schoolmates, loves bloodthirsty stories, and takes pleasure in minor mischief such as pulling expressions or tormenting cats.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c9 P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c19 P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c25 P41](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0041), [v3 c28 P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000), [v3 c38 P9](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0009), [v4 c9 P27](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0027)_

## History

Following the death of his mother, Mary Joe, eight-year-old Robin and his twin sister Lucy were taken from East Welby to live at Grey Shutters by their relative Thirza Abernethy. During the journey, his restless activity severely anxious Thirza, but he quickly warmed up to his guardians, developing a deep affection for Nell Harcourt. At Grey Shutters, he became notorious for constant mischief, such as leaning over the well to find out where the dark goes, plucking tail feathers from Mr. Pettifer's bird, and falling off a pantry table into lemon pies. Nell helped smooth over his religious confusion and persuaded him to keep clean. Upon enrolling in school, he befriended his desk mate Milty Gammon, went fishing with him and the Cottons, and engaged in typical schoolyard games. Though initially harboring a dislike for Cedric Stanhope due to Nell's praise, Robin grew to like him after starting school. Over time, he outgrew his troublemaking ways, grew taller, developed a strong interest in agriculture, and sought permission to manage the Grey Shutters farm in the coming year.

- Father died shortly after his birth  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- Mother was Mary Joe, who suffered long-term poor health before passing away  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c18 P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011)</sub>

## Quotes

> Being a minister is not my plan. My intention is to become a shopkeeper, similar to Mr. Blair, and stock huge quantities of candy and bananas.  <sub>[v2 c14 P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031)</sub>

> I’m fond of Lucy on account of her being my sister, yet my fondness for you stems from who you are.  <sub>[v2 c19 P41](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0041)</sub>

> School strikes me as wonderful entertainment. It turned out you were right about the difficulty of remaining motionless . . . I've observed that your statements are usually truthful . . . yet shifting your legs beneath the furniture provides considerable relief.  <sub>[v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001)</sub>

> Oh, my liking for Cedric has grown considerably. His superior virtue isn't as bothersome to me now that my own has improved quite a bit.  <sub>[v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005)</sub>

> My intention is to reach one hundred years of age, similar to Mr. Thomas Scobie of Pale Sands. He claims his longevity is due to always smoking tobacco, which destroyed every germ. Will I be allowed to smoke tobacco fairly soon, Nell?  <sub>[v3 c14 P43](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0043)</sub>
